source_guard_mapping.reject_reason_6_means: add_graupel_diffusion_mixture returned invalid for the pair-4 fallback candidate; this is not joint_moment_store failure_stage 6.
source_guard_mapping.call_sequence: The normal pair-4 joint_moment_store candidate is invalid, so the graupel mixture fallback is attempted. Source-rate replay and transport mixture checks precede add_graupel_diffusion_mixture. That routine recomputes Q/N increments from q1/n1 and the diffusion geometry, then bit-compares them with qs64/ns64. The observed identity record is emitted on this comparison mismatch; reject_reason 6 follows. The subsequent mixture store, which would set reason 4, is not reached.
source_guard_mapping.known_source_difference: The recorded qs64/ns64 source payload bits are nonzero, while both valid recomputed Q/N diffusion increments are +0. qa64/na64 are captured as negative zero in the trial-reject row.
source_guard_mapping.unresolved: The captured identity/trial rows do not include the actual q1/n1 5-point stencils, diffusion coefficients/metrics, carriers, density, or the decomposition/provenance of qs64/ns64 at this cell. The initial joint_moment_store invalid subpredicate is also not logged. Therefore the record localizes the failing guard but does not identify why the payload and recomputed increments differ.

source_event.cause_status: UPSTREAM_CAUSE_OPEN; zero recomputed Q/N diffusion increments are reported as valid point results, but no causal explanation is established.
